articles.summary: One AWS trn2.48xlarge serves GLM-5.3-Flash at up to 28.9 agent requests a minute on SemiAnalysis's AgentX benchmark, 3.57 million tokens a minute, and takes a million-token prompt to its first token in about three minutes. NKI layer megakernels cut its decode step from 32.2 ms to 24.2 ms.
articles.title: Serving GLM-5.3-Flash on one Trainium2 box with NKI layer megakernels
